'''Drelliad bracers''' were a type of bracers considered medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The bracers were [[brown]] in color with two parts, a thin band and a thicker band both with metallic clips attached. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound|Ace]] was given bracers of this make by the head of [[Rendia Freight]], [[Viidu]], while in [[Fort Garnik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Viidu gave it to them as thanks for finding his friend [[Reki]] in [[Talloran village]] and acquiring information about the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]'s personnel database.

==Behind the scenes==
Drelliad bracers first appeared as an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in the Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' published by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The item is available as a reward to characters of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] class for the completion of a quest in their classes storyline. The item can only be acquired in this way and so other classes can only obtain it through trading and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] players currently cannot obtain it. The bracer's relation to [[Drelliad village]], if any, is unknown.
